personal.name: Dinesh Guragain
personal.title: Full Stack .NET Developer
personal.tagline: Building secure, scalable, and enterprise-grade web applications with ASP.NET Core and modern technologies.
personal.bio: I'm a passionate Full Stack .NET Developer with over 4 years of professional experience building enterprise web applications, remittance systems, customer portals, and RESTful APIs. I specialize in ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web Forms, SQL Server, JavaScript, and third-party payment integrations. I enjoy transforming complex business requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.

experience.description: Developing enterprise remittance software using ASP.NET Web Forms and ASP.NET Core while integrating international payment partners.
highlights: Integrated GCC, GuavaPay, SendMN, InstantCash, AliPay and SacomBank APIs.
Implemented exchange rate and payment APIs.
Created transaction tracking and receipt generation modules.

experience.description: Developed remittance software and customer portal solutions using ASP.NET Core.
